header: Supported operations and plugins in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
content:
Serverless
Amazon OpenSearch Serverless supports a variety of OpenSearch plugins, as well as a subset of
the indexing, search, and metadata API operations available in OpenSearch. You can include the
permissions in the left column of the table within data access policies in order to limit access to
certain operations.
